<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 6. 上下文长度管理 ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 当对话过长时，智能裁剪历史消息</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">manageChatContext</span>(<span class="hljs-params">messages: Message[], maxTokens: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span> = <span class="hljs-number">8000</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> systemMsg = messages.<span class="hljs-title function_">find</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">m</span> =&gt;</span> m.<span class="hljs-property">role</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'system'</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> chatMsgs = messages.<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">m</span> =&gt;</span> m.<span class="hljs-property">role</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'system'</span>)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> tokens = <span class="hljs-title function_">estimateTokens</span>(systemMsg?.<span class="hljs-property">content</span> || <span class="hljs-string">''</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">kept</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Message</span>[] = []

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 从最新的消息开始保留</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = chatMsgs.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; i &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i--) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> msgTokens = <span class="hljs-title function_">estimateTokens</span>(chatMsgs[i].<span class="hljs-property">content</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (tokens + msgTokens &gt; maxTokens) <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
    kept.<span class="hljs-title function_">unshift</span>(chatMsgs[i])
    tokens += msgTokens
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> systemMsg ? [systemMsg, ...kept] : kept
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">12. 前端 AI 应用的技术架构？</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-diff" lang="diff">典型的前端 AI 应用架构：

┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│              前端层                    │
│  ├── React/Vue 应用                   │
│  ├── 流式渲染（SSE/WebSocket）         │
│  ├── Markdown 渲染 + 代码高亮         │
│  ├── 对话管理（历史/分支/搜索）        │
│  └── 文件上传（图片/文档/音频）        │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│              BFF / API 层             │
│  ├── 认证鉴权                         │
│  ├── 限流和计费                       │
│  ├── Prompt 管理                      │
│  ├── 上下文管理                       │
│  ├── 请求代理 + 流式转发              │
│  └── 日志和监控                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│              AI 服务层                 │
│  ├── LLM API（OpenAI/Claude/本地模型） │
│  ├── Embedding 服务                   │
│  ├── 向量数据库（Supabase/Pinecone）  │
│  ├── RAG Pipeline                     │
│  └── Agent Framework                  │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│              数据层                    │
│  ├── 对话历史存储                     │
│  ├── 知识库文档                       │
│  ├── 用户配置和偏好                   │
│  └── 反馈和评估数据                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘

关键技术选型：
<span class="hljs-deletion">- 前端：React/Vue + Vercel AI SDK + react-markdown</span>
<span class="hljs-deletion">- BFF：Next.js API Routes / Express / Hono</span>
<span class="hljs-deletion">- LLM：OpenAI API / Claude API / 本地 Ollama</span>
<span class="hljs-deletion">- 向量 DB：Supabase(pgvector) / Pinecone / Qdrant</span>
<span class="hljs-deletion">- 存储：PostgreSQL + Redis</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">13. 什么是 MCP（Model Context Protocol）？</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// MCP 是 Anthropic 推出的开放协议，标准化了 AI 应用与外部数据/工具的连接</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== MCP 核心概念 ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">/*
MCP 定义了三种原语：

1. Resources（资源）：提供上下文数据
   - 类似 REST API 的 GET 端点
   - 示例：文件内容、数据库记录、API 响应

2. Tools（工具）：可被模型调用执行操作
   - 类似 Function Calling
   - 示例：搜索、发邮件、创建文件

3. Prompts（提示模板）：预定义的提示词模板
   - 类似于可参数化的 Prompt 模板
   - 示例：代码审查模板、翻译模板
*/</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== MCP Server 示例（TypeScript SDK）==========</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">McpServer</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">ResourceTemplate</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">StdioServerTransport</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> server = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">McpServer</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'my-mcp-server'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">version</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'1.0.0'</span>
})

<span class="hljs-comment">// 注册资源</span>
server.<span class="hljs-title function_">resource</span>(
  <span class="hljs-string">'file'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResourceTemplate</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'file://{path}'</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">list</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span> }),
  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (uri, { path }) =&gt; ({
    <span class="hljs-attr">contents</span>: [{
      <span class="hljs-attr">uri</span>: uri.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">readFile</span>(path, <span class="hljs-string">'utf-8'</span>),
      <span class="hljs-attr">mimeType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'text/plain'</span>
    }]
  })
)

<span class="hljs-comment">// 注册工具</span>
server.<span class="hljs-title function_">tool</span>(
  <span class="hljs-string">'search_code'</span>,
  { <span class="hljs-attr">query</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'string'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">description</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'搜索关键词'</span> } },
  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> ({ query }) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">searchCodebase</span>(query)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { <span class="hljs-attr">content</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'text'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(results) }] }
  }
)

<span class="hljs-comment">// 启动服务</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> transport = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">StdioServerTransport</span>()
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> server.<span class="hljs-title function_">connect</span>(transport)

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== MCP 的价值 ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">/*
传统方式：每个 AI 应用单独对接各种数据源
  ChatGPT Plugin → 自定义 API
  Claude → 自定义 API
  本地 AI → 自定义 API
  → N 个 AI × M 个数据源 = N×M 个连接

MCP 方式：统一协议，一次实现，处处可用
  AI 应用 → MCP Client → MCP Server → 数据源
  → 只需 N + M 个实现
*/</span>
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>💡 <strong>面试加分点：</strong> MCP 是 AI 应用的"USB-C"——就像 USB-C 统一了充电接口一样，MCP 统一了 AI 与外部世界的连接方式。目前 Claude Desktop、VS Code Copilot、Cursor 等主流 AI 工具都已支持 MCP。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">14. 前端如何使用本地/边缘 AI 模型？</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 1. WebLLM：浏览器内运行 LLM ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用 WebGPU 在浏览器中运行 LLM（如 Llama、Phi）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> * <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> webllm <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@mlc-ai/web-llm'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">initLocalLLM</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {

    <span class="hljs-attr">initProgressCallback</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">progress</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`模型加载: <span class="hljs-subst">${(progress.progress * <span class="hljs-number">100</span>).toFixed(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)}</span>%`</span>)
    }
  })

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 像使用 OpenAI API 一样使用</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> response = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> engine.<span class="hljs-property">chat</span>.<span class="hljs-property">completions</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">messages</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'user'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">content</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'什么是闭包？'</span> }],
    <span class="hljs-attr">temperature</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.7</span>
  })

  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(response.<span class="hljs-property">choices</span>[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>].<span class="hljs-property">message</span>.<span class="hljs-property">content</span>)
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 2. Transformers.js：浏览器中的 Hugging Face ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { pipeline } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@xenova/transformers'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 文本分类</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> classifier = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pipeline</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'sentiment-analysis'</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">classifier</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'这个产品太棒了！'</span>)
<span class="hljs-comment">// [{ label: 'POSITIVE', score: 0.9998 }]</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 文本生成</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> generator = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pipeline</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'text-generation'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Xenova/gpt2'</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> text = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">generator</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'The future of AI is'</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">max_length</span>: <span class="hljs-number">50</span> })

<span class="hljs-comment">// 图片分类</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> imageClassifier = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pipeline</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'image-classification'</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> imgResult = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">imageClassifier</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'https://example.com/cat.jpg'</span>)
<span class="hljs-comment">// [{ label: 'cat', score: 0.99 }]</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 语音识别</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> transcriber = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pipeline</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'automatic-speech-recognition'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Xenova/whisper-tiny'</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> transcript = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">transcriber</span>(audioBlob)
<span class="hljs-comment">// { text: '今天天气很好' }</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 3. ONNX Runtime Web ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 在浏览器中运行 ONNX 模型</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> * <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> ort <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'onnxruntime-web'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">runModel</span>(<span class="hljs-params">input: <span class="hljs-built_in">Float32Array</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> session = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> ort.<span class="hljs-property">InferenceSession</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/model.onnx'</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tensor = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> ort.<span class="hljs-title class_">Tensor</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'float32'</span>, input, [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">224</span>, <span class="hljs-number">224</span>])
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> session.<span class="hljs-title function_">run</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">input</span>: tensor })
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> results.<span class="hljs-property">output</span>.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 4. TensorFlow.js ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> * <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> tf <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@tensorflow/tfjs'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 图片识别</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> model = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> tf.<span class="hljs-title function_">loadLayersModel</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/model/model.json'</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> img = tf.<span class="hljs-property">browser</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromPixels</span>(imageElement)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> prediction = model.<span class="hljs-title function_">predict</span>(img.<span class="hljs-title function_">expandDims</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>))

<span class="hljs-comment">// 实时姿态检测</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> * <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> poseDetection <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@tensorflow-models/pose-detection'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> detector = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> poseDetection.<span class="hljs-title function_">createDetector</span>(
  poseDetection.<span class="hljs-property">SupportedModels</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MoveNet</span>
)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> poses = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> detector.<span class="hljs-title function_">estimatePoses</span>(videoElement)
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>💡 <strong>面试加分点：</strong> 浏览器端 AI 的优势——<strong>隐私保护</strong>（数据不出设备）、<strong>零延迟</strong>（无网络请求）、<strong>离线可用</strong>。WebGPU 的普及将大幅提升浏览器端 AI 的性能，使更大的模型可以在客户端运行。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">15. AI 编程助手的原理和使用技巧？</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// AI 编程助手（GitHub Copilot、CodeBuddy、Cursor 等）的核心原理</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 原理 ==========</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">/*
1. 代码补全（Autocomplete）
   - 输入：光标前后的代码上下文
   - 模型：专门针对代码训练的 LLM
   - 输出：预测接下来的代码

2. 聊天式编程（Chat）
   - 输入：用户自然语言描述 + 代码上下文
   - 处理：检索相关代码文件 + Prompt 组装
   - 输出：代码修改建议、解释、调试方案

3. Agent 模式
   - 自主规划和执行多步编码任务
   - 读取文件 → 理解代码 → 编写代码 → 运行测试 → 修复问题
*/</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// ========== 高效使用 AI 编程助手的技巧 ==========</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 写好注释，引导代码补全</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 详细的注释可以让 AI 生成更准确的代码</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 防抖函数：在指定延迟后执行回调，期间如果再次触发则重置计时器</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 参数：fn - 要执行的函数，delay - 延迟毫秒数</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 返回：防抖后的函数</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">debounce</span>(<span class="hljs-params">fn: <span class="hljs-built_in">Function</span>, delay: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// AI 会基于注释生成完整实现</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 提供类型信息</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">User</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">email</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'admin'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'user'</span>
}
<span class="hljs-comment">// 有了接口定义，AI 生成 CRUD 代码会更准确</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 写好函数签名</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUsers</span>(<span class="hljs-params">params: {
  page: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
  pageSize: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
  search?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  role?: User[<span class="hljs-string">'role'</span>]
}</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;{ <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">User</span>[]; <span class="hljs-attr">total</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span> }&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// AI 根据参数和返回类型生成实现</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 在聊天中提供上下文</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">/*
  好的提问：
  "这个 React 组件在列表超过 1000 条时卡顿，
   请帮我添加虚拟滚动优化。
   当前使用 @tanstack/react-virtual 库。"

  不好的提问：
  "这个组件很慢，帮我优化一下"
*/</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 5. 分步骤完成复杂任务</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 先让 AI 理解需求和设计方案</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 然后逐个文件生成代码</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 最后让 AI 审查和优化</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">16. 前端 AI 发展趋势？</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">2024-2025 前端 AI 关键趋势：

<span class="hljs-bullet">1.</span> AI Native 应用
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 从"在应用中嵌入 AI"到"以 AI 为核心设计应用"
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 对话式交互替代传统 GUI
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> AI Agent 处理复杂工作流

<span class="hljs-bullet">2.</span> 端侧 AI（On-device AI）
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> WebGPU 成熟 → 浏览器端运行更大模型
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 小模型（&lt; 3B 参数）足够处理很多任务
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 隐私计算、离线能力

<span class="hljs-bullet">3.</span> 多模态
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 文本 + 图片 + 语音 + 视频的统一理解和生成
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 前端需要处理多种媒体格式的输入输出

<span class="hljs-bullet">4.</span> AI 驱动的 UI/UX
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 自然语言驱动界面操作
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> AI 自适应界面（根据用户行为自动调整）
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 智能表单、智能搜索成为标配

<span class="hljs-bullet">5.</span> AI 开发工具
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> AI 编程助手成为标配（Copilot、Cursor、CodeBuddy）
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> AI 代码审查、AI 测试生成
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 自然语言生成 UI（v0.dev、Bolt.new）

<span class="hljs-bullet">6.</span> MCP 协议生态
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 标准化 AI 与外部数据/工具的连接
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 前端开发者需要理解和开发 MCP Server

<span class="hljs-bullet">7.</span> RAG 和知识库
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 企业级 AI 应用的标配
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 前端需要构建知识管理和搜索界面

<span class="hljs-bullet">8.</span> AI 安全和治理
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> Prompt 注入防护
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> AI 输出的安全过滤
<span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span> 数据隐私合规
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>💡 <strong>面试加分点：</strong> 对于前端开发者来说，AI 不只是一个需要接入的功能，更是一种<strong>全新的交互范式</strong>。未来的前端开发者需要：1）理解 AI 基础概念；2）会使用 AI 开发工具提升效率；3）能构建 AI Native 的用户体验；4）了解 AI 安全和伦理问题。</p>
</blockquote></div></div>
